sql_templates.query:
SELECT e.symbol, e.close, s.enhanced_fund_score, v.rank
FROM market.equity_eod AS e
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS s ON e.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks AS v ON s.symbol = v.symbol
WHERE e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND v.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
AND v.vcp_score > 80
ORDER BY v.rank ASC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.label: Insider Alerts and Bulk Deals
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (
        SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal
        FROM scores.stage_snapshots
        WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
      )
      SELECT i.symbol, i.alert_date, i.entity, i.insider_score, b.deal_date, b.qty, b.price,
             s.stage, s.trading_signal
      FROM signals.insider_alerts i
      JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol
      JOIN latest_stage s ON i.symbol = s.symbol
      WHERE s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
      ORDER BY i.alert_date DESC, b.deal_date DESC
      LIMIT 20
